## Cold open

> SCENE (states): Hamburg lights up on the map of Germany.
> Hamburg | Stadtstaat

[dramatic] [[Hamburg]], on the river Elbe, is a city and a state at once: the Free and Hanseatic City of Hamburg. It has Germany's biggest port, and nearly two million people.

[dramatic] If you take the citizenship test in Hamburg, three of your thirty-three questions are about the state you live in. They come from a list of just ten. Here are all ten, with the answers.

> SCENE (title): Title card.
> HAMBURG

## On the map

{Q358}

> SCENE (question): Question card #358. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] The exam shows a map with four states, numbered. [[Welches Bundesland ist Hamburg?]] Which federal state is Hamburg?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[3]]. Number three: the city-state in the north, on the Elbe.


{Q357}

> SCENE (question): Question card #357. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welches Bundesland ist ein Stadtstaat?]] Which federal state is a city-state?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Hamburg]]. There are three city-states: Berlin, Hamburg and Bremen. Each one is a city and a state at the same time.


## Flag and coat of arms

{Q355}

> SCENE (question): Question card #355. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welche Farben hat die Landesflagge von Hamburg?]] What are the colors of the state flag of Hamburg?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[weiß-rot]]. White and red: the white castle on red.


{Q351}

> SCENE (question): Question card #351. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] The exam shows four coats of arms. [[Welches Wappen gehört zur Freien und Hansestadt Hamburg?]] Which coat of arms belongs to the Free and Hanseatic City of Hamburg?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Bild 2]], picture two: a white castle with three towers on a red shield.


## How it's run

{Q352}

> SCENE (question): Question card #352. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welches ist ein Bezirk von Hamburg?]] Which of these is a district of Hamburg?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Altona]]. The others are elsewhere: [[Hemelingen]] is in [[Bremen]], [[Pankow]] is in [[Berlin]], and [[Mecklenburgische Seenplatte]] is in [[Mecklenburg-Vorpommern]].


{Q353}

> SCENE (question): Question card #353. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Für wie viele Jahre wird das Landesparlament in Hamburg gewählt?]] For how many years is the state parliament in Hamburg elected?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[5]]. Five years, like almost every state parliament.


{Q354}

> SCENE (question): Question card #354. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Ab welchem Alter darf man in Hamburg bei Kommunalwahlen (Wahl der Bezirksversammlungen) wählen?]] At what age are you allowed to vote in local elections (district assembly elections) in Hamburg?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[16]]. Here, you can vote in local elections from sixteen. It differs from state to state. For the Bundestag, it's eighteen everywhere.


{Q359}

> SCENE (question): Question card #359. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Erste Bürgermeisterin oder Erster Bürgermeister

[dramatic] [[Wie nennt man die Regierungschefin oder den Regierungschef des Stadtstaates Hamburg?]] What is the head of government of the city-state of Hamburg called?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Erste Bürgermeisterin oder Erster Bürgermeister]], the first mayor. In Hamburg, the senate is the state government, and the first mayor leads it.


{Q360}

> SCENE (question): Question card #360. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Senatorin oder Senator für Außenbeziehungen

[dramatic] And a question with a [[nicht]]. [[Welche Senatorin oder welchen Senator hat Hamburg nicht?]] Which senator does Hamburg not have?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Senatorin oder Senator für Außenbeziehungen]], a senator for foreign relations. In a city-state, the ministers are called senators. Finance, justice and the interior: Hamburg has all of those. Foreign policy is the federation's job.


{Q356}

> SCENE (question): Question card #356. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Wo können Sie sich in Hamburg über politische Themen informieren?]] Where can you find information on political topics in Hamburg?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[bei der Landeszentrale für politische Bildung]], the state centre for civic education. Every state has one. It's free, it belongs to no party, and it has material on politics in plain language.


## What to remember for the exam

> SCENE (words): The words appear one by one, then settle into a grid.
> Altona, weiß-rot, Erster Bürgermeister

[dramatic] Three answers to hold on to: [[Altona]]. [[weiß-rot]]. And [[Erster Bürgermeister]].
